```{julia}

@rput temp
R"""
library(tidyverse)
temp |> ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
        x = date, 
        mean_temperature_degree_c)) + 
    geom_line() +
    labs(
        x = NULL, 
        y = "Mean Temperature (in Celsius)", 
        title = "Are the patterns for each Sensor Depth Different?"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~sensor_depth_at_low_tide_m)

ggsave("./tt_plot2.pdf")

"""

```

```{julia}

temp.log_mean_temp = log.(temp.mean_temperature_degree_c)

sensors = unique(temp.sensor_depth_at_low_tide_m)

# --- Time Series Models --- #

fcs = []

for s in unique(temp.sensor_depth_at_low_tide_m)

    tmp_temp = temp[temp.sensor_depth_at_low_tide_m .== s, :]

    rows = nrow(tmp_temp) - 100

    temp_train = tmp_temp[1:rows, :]

    temp_test = tmp_temp[(rows+1):end, :]

    ar_mod = auto_arima(temp_train.log_mean_temp, 12)

    fc = Durbyn.forecast(ar_mod, h = 20)
    push!(fcs, fc)

end

```


```{julia}
#| include: true

plt_list = []
for p in 1:length(sensors)
    sens = sensors[p]
    println("Sensor Depth = $sens")
    println(fcs[p].method)
    p_temp= Durbyn.plot(fcs[p])
    title!("Sensor Depth: $sens")

    push!(plt_list, p_temp)
end

Plots.plot(
    plt_list..., 
    size = (1500, 800), 
    legend = false
)

savefig("plot2.pdf")
```
